scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a six-month beginner run-walk plan, [X] uses shorts for warm-weather intervals after repeated notes show that cooling, sweat release, free knee movement, and reduced wet-fabric retention matter more than lower-leg coverage on the chosen routes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在持续六个月的初学跑走计划中，[X]根据多次记录选择在温暖天气训练时穿短裤，因为在既定路线中，散热、排汗、膝部活动自由和减少湿布料滞留比小腿覆盖更重要。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week on an Australian trail, [X] selects lightweight full-length pants because cold starts, abrasive scrub, strong sun, mud, rain, gaiters, and a heavy water load make continuous lower-leg protection more valuable than maximum ventilation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 规划一周澳大利亚步道行程时，[X]选择轻薄长裤，因为寒冷清晨、灌木刮擦、强日晒、泥泞雨水、绑腿和沉重饮水负荷，使持续的小腿防护比最大通风更重要。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a warm R&B stadium concert, [X] selects shorts that stay cool and unrestricted through concrete approaches, steep stairs, hard seats, packed rows, and hours of dancing, with a closed front compartment securing the phone and car key during the exit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加温暖的体育场 R&B 演唱会时，[X]选择能在水泥路、陡坡、硬座、拥挤座席和数小时舞动中保持凉爽且不限制动作的短裤，并用可闭合的前侧收纳在退场时固定手机与车钥匙。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a deliberately relaxed outdoor team day in hot weather, [X] selects neat shorts that allow lawn games, low seating, food-station movement, and informal photos while staying inside the event's explicitly casual dress code.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在炎热天气下参加明确定位为轻松休闲的户外团队活动时，[X]选择整洁的短裤，以适应草地游戏、低位座椅、自助餐区走动和非正式合影，同时符合活动明示的休闲着装要求。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an afternoon campus reunion with no dress code, [X] keeps the specifically shortlisted dark jeans from a familiar casual wardrobe because they handle walking, long seated conversation, and a modestly polished presentation without becoming formal.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在没有着装要求的午后校园同学聚会前，[X]保留从熟悉休闲衣橱中明确选出的深色牛仔裤，因为它能兼顾步行、长时间坐聊和适度整洁的形象，又不会变得正式。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual eyeglass-fitting outing at about one degree Celsius, [X] selects full-length pants for warmth during outdoor travel and comfort while seated, keeping the silhouette quiet so attention stays on the frames.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在约 1 摄氏度天气下外出试戴眼镜时，[X]选择长裤，以保证室外路程中的保暖和试戴久坐时的舒适，同时让轮廓保持低调，使注意力集中在镜框上。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cloudy, slightly cold day, [X] builds around an owned thin black bomber and selects full-length pants to preserve warmth, handle damp ground, and create a continuous dark line into the chosen shoes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在阴天且略冷的一天，[X]围绕已有的轻薄黑色飞行夹克搭配，并选择长裤以维持保暖、应对潮湿地面，同时与所选鞋子形成连续的深色线条。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On the forecast's warmest dry day of a spring Marseille-Cassis trip, [X] selects shorts for the Calanques walk, waterfront movement, and long casual lunch, reserving the cooler or rain-prone day for different clothing rather than forcing one lower-body form across the trip.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 春季马赛与卡西斯行程中天气预报最温暖干燥的一天，[X]选择短裤用于卡朗格步行、滨水活动和长时间休闲午餐，并把更凉或可能下雨的日子交给其他穿着，不强迫同一件下装覆盖整趟旅行。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Moving among Dubai's desert heat, intensely air-conditioned interiors, public-space modesty expectations, and smart-casual dining, [X] selects lightweight full-length pants that satisfy coverage and indoor comfort without becoming heavy outdoors.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在迪拜的沙漠高温、强冷气室内、公共场所端庄要求和商务休闲餐厅之间切换时，[X]选择轻薄长裤，在不让户外穿着变得厚重的同时满足覆盖与室内舒适需求。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping in Ireland for an Italian summer, [X] follows an explicit preference for cool comfortable shorts and selects a breathable pair for cobblestone walking and ordinary hot daytime plans, leaving church visits and polished dinners to separately scheduled outfits.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在爱尔兰为意大利夏季旅行购置衣物时，[X]遵循自己对凉爽舒适短裤的明确偏好，为石板路步行和普通炎热日间活动选择一条透气短裤，并把教堂参观和讲究晚餐安排给单独的穿搭。
